a wide range of.def_zh: 各种各样的(后接复数名词)
a wide range of.example_en: The library offers a wide range of resources for students.
a wide range of.example_zh: 图书馆为学生提供各种各样的资源。

play a key role.example_en: Effective communication plays a key role in team success.
play a key role.example_zh: 有效的沟通在团队成功中发挥关键作用。

take into account.example_en: We need to take into account the potential risks before proceeding.
take into account.example_zh: 在继续之前，我们需要考虑到潜在的风险。

it is clear that....def_zh: 显而易见的是(句首,引出显见事实,学术或新闻)
it is clear that....example_en: It is clear that climate change affects biodiversity globally.
it is clear that....example_zh: 显而易见的是,气候变化在全球范围内影响生物多样性。

it is possible that....def_zh: 有可能的是(句首,引出假设或可能性,学术或新闻)
it is possible that....example_en: It is possible that new technologies will solve this issue.
it is possible that....example_zh: 有可能的是,新技术会解决这个问题。

as a result.def_zh: 因此(须有明确因果,不作泛泛承接)
as a result.example_en: The experiment failed, and as a result, the hypothesis was rejected.
as a result.example_zh: 实验失败,因此假设被否定了。

on the contrary.def_zh: 恰恰相反(纠正前句,非对比)
on the contrary.example_en: Some believe the policy will harm the economy; on the contrary, it could boost growth.
on the contrary.example_zh: 一些人认为该政策会损害经济;恰恰相反,它可能促进增长。

look into.def_zh: 调查(look into sth,宾语不插中间)
look into.example_en: The manager promised to look into the issue by tomorrow.
look into.example_zh: 经理承诺在明天之前调查这个问题。

come up with.def_zh: 想出(come up with sth,宾语不插中间)
come up with.example_en: She came up with a brilliant idea for the project.
come up with.example_zh: 她为这个项目想出了一个绝妙的主意。

set up.def_zh: 建立(set sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
set up.example_en: They set up the new system in just two days.
set up.example_zh: 他们在短短两天内建立了新系统。

carry on.example_en: Despite the difficulties, they decided to carry on with the plan.
carry on.example_zh: 尽管困难重重,他们决定继续执行计划。

separability.basis: 本义不及物,carry sth on 罕用不教

in addition.def_zh: 此外(用于补充,不用于递进)
in addition.example_en: The study was successful; in addition, it received international recognition.
in addition.example_zh: 这项研究取得了成功；此外,还获得了国际认可。

in other words.def_zh: 换句话说(用于解释,不用于总结)
in other words.example_en: The results were inconclusive; in other words, more research is needed.
in other words.example_zh: 结果尚不明确；换句话说,还需要更多研究。

on the other hand.def_zh: 另一方面(用于对比,不用于转折)
on the other hand.example_en: The economy is growing; on the other hand, unemployment remains high.
on the other hand.example_zh: 经济在增长；另一方面,失业率仍然很高。

for example.def_zh: 例如(用于举例,不用于列举)
for example.example_en: Many animals are endangered; for example, the giant panda is at risk.
for example.example_zh: 许多动物濒临灭绝；例如,大熊猫正面临危险。

as a consequence.def_zh: 结果是(有明确因果,非泛泛承接)
as a consequence.example_en: The experiment failed; as a consequence, the hypothesis was rejected.
as a consequence.example_zh: 实验失败了；结果是,假设被否定了。

in fact.def_zh: 事实上(用于强调,不用于转折)
in fact.example_en: He claimed to be an expert; in fact, he had no experience.
in fact.example_zh: 他自称是专家；事实上,他没有经验。

in summary.def_zh: 总结来说(用于总结,不用于解释)
in summary.example_en: In summary, the project was a success despite initial challenges.
in summary.example_zh: 总结来说,尽管最初面临挑战,该项目取得了成功。

in contrast.def_zh: 相比之下(比较两者,不纠正前句)
in contrast.example_en: The north is cold; in contrast, the south is warm and sunny.
in contrast.example_zh: 北方寒冷；相比之下,南方温暖而阳光明媚。

as a result of.def_zh: 由于(表示原因,不用于结果)
as a result of.example_en: The river flooded as a result of heavy rainfall.
as a result of.example_zh: 由于降雨量大,河流泛滥了。

in particular.def_zh: 尤其是(用于强调,不用于列举)
in particular.example_en: European art is diverse; in particular, Italian Renaissance art is notable.
in particular.example_zh: 欧洲艺术多样化；尤其是,意大利文艺复兴艺术尤为显著。

in conclusion.def_zh: 总之(用于结尾,不用于过渡)
in conclusion.example_en: In conclusion, climate change is a pressing global issue.
in conclusion.example_zh: 总之,气候变化是一个紧迫的全球性问题。

in spite of.def_zh: 尽管(用于让步,不用于因果)
in spite of.example_en: In spite of the rain, we decided to go hiking.
in spite of.example_zh: 尽管下雨,我们还是决定去远足。

as long as.def_zh: 只要(用于条件,不用于时间)
as long as.example_en: You can join the meeting as long as you finish your work.
as long as.example_zh: 只要你完成工作,就可以参加会议。

find out.def_zh: 查明(find sth out 可分,代词须插中间)
find out.example_en: She needs to find out the truth about her family.
find out.example_zh: 她需要查明关于她家庭的真相。

turn down.def_zh: 拒绝(turn sth down 可分,代词须插中间)
turn down.example_en: He decided to turn down the job offer.
turn down.example_zh: 他决定拒绝这份工作邀请。

figure out.def_zh: 弄清楚(figure sth out 可分,代词须插中间)
figure out.example_en: I can't figure out how to solve this problem.
figure out.example_zh: 我无法弄清楚如何解决这个问题。

take over.def_zh: 接管(take sth over 可分,代词须插中间)
take over.example_en: The company will take over the smaller firm next month.
take over.example_zh: 这家公司将于下个月接管这家小公司。

make up.def_zh: 组成(make sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
make up.example_en: Water makes up about 70% of the human body.

come across.def_zh: 偶然遇到(come across sth,宾语不插中间)
come across.example_en: I came across an old friend at the market yesterday.
come across.example_zh: 我昨天在市场上偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

run into.def_zh: 偶然碰到(run into sth,宾语不插中间)
run into.example_en: I ran into my teacher at the bookstore.
run into.example_zh: 我在书店偶然碰到了我的老师。

look after.def_zh: 照顾(look after sth,宾语不插中间)
look after.example_en: She looks after her younger brother every weekend.
look after.example_zh: 她每个周末都照顾她的弟弟。

put off.def_zh: 推迟(put sth off 可分,代词须插中间)
put off.example_en: They decided to put off the meeting until next week.
put off.example_zh: 他们决定将会议推迟到下周。

bring up.def_zh: 提起(bring sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
bring up.example_en: She brought up an interesting point during the discussion.
bring up.example_zh: 她在讨论中提起了一个有趣的观点。

break down.def_zh: 分解(break sth down 可分,代词须插中间)
break down.example_en: The scientist broke down the complex process into simple steps.
break down.example_zh: 科学家将复杂的过程分解成简单的步骤。

give up.def_zh: 放弃(give sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
give up.example_en: She decided to give up smoking for her health.
give up.example_zh: 她决定为了健康而放弃吸烟。

take off.def_zh: 脱下(take sth off 可分,代词须插中间)
take off.example_en: He took off his coat and hung it by the door.

pick up.def_zh: 捡起(pick sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
pick up.example_en: He picked up the book from the floor.

turn up.def_zh: 出现(turn sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
turn up.example_en: He turned up at the party unexpectedly.
turn up.example_zh: 他出乎意料地出现在聚会上。

set off.def_zh: 出发(set sth off 可分,代词须插中间)
set off.example_en: They set off on their journey early in the morning.

look forward to.def_zh: 期待(look forward to sth,宾语不插中间)
look forward to.example_en: I look forward to the weekend.

put up with.def_zh: 忍受(put up with sth,宾语不插中间)
put up with.example_en: She can't put up with the noise any longer.
put up with.example_zh: 她再也无法忍受这种噪音了。

turn out.def_zh: 结果是(不及物,不带宾语)
turn out.example_en: It turned out that the weather was perfect for a picnic.
turn out.example_zh: 结果天气非常适合野餐。

separability.basis: 「结果是」义不及物(It turned out that…)

call off.def_zh: 取消(call sth off 可分,代词须插中间)
call off.example_en: They had to call off the event due to rain.
call off.example_zh: 他们不得不因为下雨取消活动。

go on.example_en: After a short break, they went on with their work.
go on.example_zh: 短暂休息后，他们继续工作。

put out.def_zh: 扑灭(put sth out 可分,代词须插中间)
put out.example_en: Firefighters managed to put out the fire quickly.
put out.example_zh: 消防员迅速扑灭了火灾。

show up.example_en: He didn't show up for the meeting.

back up.def_zh: 支持(back sth up 可分,代词须插中间)
back up.example_en: She always backs up her arguments with evidence.
back up.example_zh: 她总是用证据支持她的论点。

take on.def_zh: 承担(take sth on 可分,代词须插中间)
take on.example_en: She decided to take on more responsibilities at work.
take on.example_zh: 她决定在工作中承担更多责任。

break out.example_en: A fire broke out in the building last night.
break out.example_zh: 昨晚大楼里发生了火灾。

separability.basis: 「爆发」义不及物,无 break sth out

take apart.def_zh: 拆开(take sth apart 可分,代词须插中间)
take apart.example_en: He took apart the computer to fix it.
take apart.example_zh: 他拆开了电脑进行修理。

go over.def_zh: 复习(go over sth,宾语不插中间)
go over.example_en: Let's go over the main points of the lecture.
go over.example_zh: 让我们复习一下讲座的要点。

separability.basis: go 不及物,over 为介词

bring about.def_zh: 导致(bring about sth,宾语不插中间)
bring about.example_en: The new policy will bring about significant changes.
bring about.example_zh: 新政策将带来重大变革。

cut down on.def_zh: 减少(cut down on sth,宾语不插中间)
cut down on.example_en: She needs to cut down on sugar for her health.
cut down on.example_zh: 为了健康，她需要减少糖的摄入。

give away.def_zh: 赠送(give sth away 可分,代词须插中间)
give away.example_en: She decided to give away her old clothes to charity.
give away.example_zh: 她决定把旧衣服捐赠给慈善机构。

based on.example_en: The decision was made based on the latest data.
based on.example_zh: 这个决定是基于最新数据做出的。

in order to.example_en: He studied hard in order to pass the exam.
in order to.example_zh: 他努力学习为了通过考试。

as well as.example_en: The course covers biology as well as chemistry.
as well as.example_zh: 这门课程涵盖生物学以及化学。

due to.example_en: The event was canceled due to bad weather.

pay attention to.example_en: Students should pay attention to the teacher's instructions.
pay attention to.example_zh: 学生应该注意老师的指示。

in relation to.example_en: The report discusses climate change in relation to agriculture.
in relation to.example_zh: 报告讨论了气候变化与农业的关系。

in charge of.example_en: She is in charge of the marketing department.

in response to.example_en: The company issued a statement in response to the allegations.
in response to.example_zh: 公司发布声明回应指控。

take advantage of.example_en: We should take advantage of the new technology.

in favor of.example_en: The majority voted in favor of the new policy.
in favor of.example_zh: 多数人投票赞成新政策。

be aware of.example_en: You should be aware of the potential risks.
be aware of.example_zh: 你应该意识到潜在的风险。

in line with.example_en: The new procedures are in line with company policy.

be capable of.example_en: This robot is capable of learning new tasks.
be capable of.example_zh: 这个机器人能够学习新任务。

be familiar with.example_en: He is familiar with the company's procedures.

in accordance with.example_en: The project was completed in accordance with the guidelines.
in accordance with.example_zh: 项目依照指导方针完成。

be involved in.example_en: She is involved in several research projects.
be involved in.example_zh: 她参与了几个研究项目。

be responsible for.example_en: He is responsible for managing the team.

be likely to.example_en: The weather is likely to improve tomorrow.

be similar to.example_en: The new design is similar to the previous model.
be similar to.example_zh: 新设计类似于之前的型号。

play a significant role.example_en: Education plays a significant role in shaping a person's future.
play a significant role.example_zh: 教育在塑造一个人的未来中发挥重要作用。

make a difference.example_en: Volunteers can make a difference in the lives of many children.
make a difference.example_zh: 志愿者可以对许多孩子的生活产生影响。

have access to.example_en: Students should have access to the latest technology in the classroom.
have access to.example_zh: 学生应该有权在教室使用最新技术。

be dependent on.example_en: The local economy is heavily dependent on tourism.
be dependent on.example_zh: 当地经济严重依赖于旅游业。

it is important to....def_zh: 重要的是(句首,强调某事的重要性)
it is important to....example_en: It is important to understand the basics before moving on.
it is important to....example_zh: 重要的是在继续之前理解基础知识。

the fact that....def_zh: 事实是(句首或句中,用于强调事实)
the fact that....example_en: The fact that the company is expanding is promising.
the fact that....example_zh: 公司正在扩张的事实令人期待。

there is a need for....def_zh: 有必要(句首,引出需求或建议)
there is a need for....example_en: There is a need for improved communication within the team.
there is a need for....example_zh: 团队内部有必要提高沟通。

it is unlikely that....def_zh: 不太可能(句首,引出否定可能性)
it is unlikely that....example_en: It is unlikely that the experiment will yield different results.
it is unlikely that....example_zh: 实验不太可能得出不同的结果。

it is essential that....def_zh: 至关重要的是(句首,引出必须做的事)
it is essential that....example_en: It is essential that patients follow the prescribed treatment plan.
it is essential that....example_zh: 至关重要的是患者遵循规定的治疗计划。

it is worth mentioning that....def_zh: 值得一提的是(句首,引出补充信息)
it is worth mentioning that....example_en: It is worth mentioning that the event was a huge success.
it is worth mentioning that....example_zh: 值得一提的是,活动非常成功。

it is not surprising that....def_zh: 不足为奇的是(句首,引出合理结果)
it is not surprising that....example_en: It is not surprising that the movie won several awards.
it is not surprising that....example_zh: 这部电影获得多个奖项不足为奇。

the extent to which....def_zh: 在多大程度上(句中,用于讨论程度)
the extent to which....example_en: The extent to which this will impact the economy is still unknown.
the extent to which....example_zh: 这将对经济产生多大影响尚不清楚。

it is assumed that....def_zh: 假设是(句首,用于引出假设或观点)
it is assumed that....example_en: It is assumed that the results will be consistent across trials.
it is assumed that....example_zh: 假设各次试验的结果将是一致的。

there is no denying that....def_zh: 不可否认的是(句首,引出无可争议的事实)
there is no denying that....example_en: There is no denying that exercise is beneficial for health.
there is no denying that....example_zh: 不可否认的是,锻炼对健康有益。

what matters most is that....def_zh: 最重要的是(句首,强调重点)
what matters most is that....example_en: What matters most is that we learn from our mistakes.
what matters most is that....example_zh: 最重要的是我们从错误中学习。

it is recommended that....def_zh: 建议(句首,用于提出建议)
it is recommended that....example_en: It is recommended that you drink plenty of water during the day.
it is recommended that....example_zh: 建议您在一天中多喝水。

it is evident that....def_zh: 显然(句首,用于引出明显结论)
it is evident that....example_en: It is evident that climate change is affecting global weather patterns.
it is evident that....example_zh: 显然,气候变化正在影响全球天气模式。

it is believed that....def_zh: 人们相信(句首,引出普遍观点或假设)
it is believed that....example_en: It is believed that the universe is constantly expanding.
it is believed that....example_zh: 人们相信宇宙在不断膨胀。

it is likely that....def_zh: 很可能(句首,引出可能性)
it is likely that....example_en: It is likely that the new policy will be implemented next year.
it is likely that....example_zh: 新政策很可能在明年实施。

the reason why....def_zh: 原因是(句中或句首,用于解释原因)
the reason why....example_en: The reason why the project was delayed is still unclear.
the reason why....example_zh: 项目延期的原因尚不清楚。

it is unfortunate that....def_zh: 不幸的是(句首,引出遗憾或不好的消息)
it is unfortunate that....example_en: It is unfortunate that the event was canceled due to the weather.
it is unfortunate that....example_zh: 不幸的是,由于天气原因,活动被取消。

it is noteworthy that....def_zh: 值得注意的是(句首,强调重要信息)
it is noteworthy that....example_en: It is noteworthy that the study received widespread attention.
it is noteworthy that....example_zh: 值得注意的是,这项研究受到了广泛关注。

carry out research.example_en: The team will carry out research on climate change impacts.
carry out research.example_zh: 该团队将进行气候变化影响的研究。

play an important role.example_en: Education plays an important role in economic development.
play an important role.example_zh: 教育在经济发展中发挥着重要作用。

pose a threat to.example_en: Pollution poses a threat to marine life in the ocean.
pose a threat to.example_zh: 污染对海洋生物构成威胁。

make an effort to.example_en: Students should make an effort to improve their grades.
make an effort to.example_zh: 学生们应该努力提高他们的成绩。
